questions.questionText: Balance the following chemical equation: H2 + O2 -> H2O
questions.studentAnswer: 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. This is balanced: there are 4 hydrogen atoms and 2 oxygen atoms on both sides.

questions.questionText: Balance the following chemical equation: N2 + H2 -> NH3
questions.studentAnswer: N2 + 2H2 -> 2NH3. This is balanced because the nitrogen atoms match on both sides.

questions.questionText: The reaction CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2 releases a large amount of heat. State whether this reaction is exothermic or endothermic, and explain in terms of energy absorbed or released.
questions.studentAnswer: This reaction is exothermic. During an exothermic reaction, energy is absorbed from the surroundings, which is why heat is given off.

questions.questionText: Balance the following chemical equation: Zn + HCl -> ZnCl2 + H2
questions.studentAnswer: Zn + HCl -> ZnCl2 + H2. This equation is already balanced.

questions.questionText: Magnesium ribbon burns in oxygen to form a white powder. Name the product formed and write the balanced chemical equation for this reaction.
questions.studentAnswer: The product is magnesium oxide (MgO), a white powder. The balanced equation is: 2Mg + O2 -> 2MgO. Magnesium and oxygen atoms are balanced on both sides (2 Mg and 2 O).
